Name: Bingus as a Scarecrow
Author: TheDogtorWho
Description:
Based on Bingus from the DechartGames Twitch streams! 

This mod replaces the sprite of the craftable scarecrow in Stardew Valley. Just replace the Craftables.xnb file with the original in the StardewValley/Content/TileSheets folder. (Make sure to save a copy of the original file from the folder, just in case there's any issues and you need a back up of the original!)

Feel free to message if you have any questions or spot any issues! :)

Twitter: [url=https://twitter.com/TheDogtor]TheDogtor[/url]
